# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
ARG NODE_VERSION=22
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION}-bookworm-slim AS base
ENV PNPM_HOME="/pnpm" \
    PATH="/pnpm:$PATH" \
    CI=true
RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.17.1 --activate
WORKDIR /app

FROM base AS deps
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml ./
COPY apps/web/package.json apps/web/
RUN --mount=type=cache,id=pnpm,target=/pnpm/store pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

FROM deps AS build
COPY . .
RUN pnpm build && pnpm prune --prod

FROM python:3.12-alpine AS tools
RUN apk add --no-cache git curl jq \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir requests==2.32.3 \
    && rm -rf /var/cache/apk/*

FROM base AS runtime
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/example/agentry" \
      maintainer="team@example.com"
ARG VERSION=dev
ENV NODE_ENV=production APP_VERSION=$VERSION
USER root
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates tini \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
 && useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash agent
COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=tools /usr/bin/jq /usr/local/bin/jq
ADD https://example.com/release.tar.gz /tmp/
VOLUME ["/data", "/workspace"]
EXPOSE 8787/tcp
USER node
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --retries=3 CMD curl -fsS http://localhost:8787/api/health || exit 1
STOPSIGNAL SIGTERM
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
ONBUILD RUN echo "built on top"
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini", "--"]
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js", "--port", "8787"]
